CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_family_member(target_family_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.family_members fm
    where fm.family_id = target_family_id
      and fm.user_id = auth.uid()
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_family_meal_menu_creator()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  new.created_by := auth.uid();
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.set_child_xp_goal(p_member_id uuid, p_goal integer, p_reward text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Not authenticated'; end if; if p_goal is null or p_goal < 1 or p_goal > 100000 or length(coalesce(p_reward,'')) > 200 then raise exception 'Invalid goal or reward'; end if; if not exists(select 1 from public.family_members target join public.family_members actor on actor.family_id=target.family_id join public.family_permissions perm on perm.family_member_id=actor.id where target.id=p_member_id and target.role='barn' and actor.user_id=auth.uid() and perm.can_manage_tasks=true) then raise exception 'Not allowed'; end if; update public.family_members set xp_goal=p_goal,xp_reward=nullif(trim(p_reward),'') where id=p_member_id and role='barn'; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.respond_to_calendar_assignment(target_event_id uuid, response text)
 RETURNS calendar_events
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  updated_event public.calendar_events;
begin
  if response is null or response not in ('accepted', 'declined') then
    raise exception 'Ogiltigt svar';
  end if;

  update public.calendar_events event
  set assignment_status = response, assignment_responded_at = now(), updated_at = now()
  from public.family_members member
  where event.id = target_event_id
    and event.responsible_member_id = member.id
    and event.family_id = member.family_id
    and member.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and (event.visible_to_children or member.role <> 'barn')
    and (event.audience_member_ids is null or member.id = any(event.audience_member_ids))
    and event.assignment_status = 'pending'
  returning event.* into updated_event;

  if updated_event.id is null then
    raise exception 'Aktiviteten väntar inte på ditt svar';
  end if;

  return updated_event;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calendar_push_config(worker_token text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when worker_token <> '' and worker_token = (
    select decrypted_secret from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'vardilo_calendar_push_worker'
  ) then (
    select decrypted_secret::jsonb from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'vardilo_calendar_push_vapid'
  ) end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.calendar_push_public_key()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select decrypted_secret::jsonb->>'publicKey'
  from vault.decrypted_secrets where name = 'vardilo_calendar_push_vapid';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_calendar_push()
 RETURNS TABLE(notification_id uuid, endpoint text, p256dh text, auth_key text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with candidates as (
    select n.id, s.endpoint
    from public.notifications n
    join public.family_members m on m.id = n.recipient_member_id and m.family_id = n.family_id
    join public.calendar_push_subscriptions s on s.user_id = m.user_id and s.created_at <= n.created_at
    left join public.calendar_events e on e.id::text = n.metadata->>'event_id' and e.family_id = n.family_id
    left join public.calendar_push_deliveries d on d.notification_id = n.id and d.endpoint = s.endpoint
    where n.created_at >= now() - interval '10 minutes' and n.read_at is null
      and ((n.type = 'calendar' and n.title = 'Kalenderpåminnelse'
        and case when pg_input_is_valid(n.metadata->>'starts_at', 'timestamp with time zone') then (n.metadata->>'starts_at')::timestamptz > now() else false end
        and e.reminder_minutes is not null and e.assignment_status <> 'declined'
        and e.responsible_member_id = m.id and (e.visible_to_children or m.role <> 'barn')
        and (e.audience_member_ids is null or m.id = any(e.audience_member_ids)))
      or (n.type='system' and n.metadata->>'action'='birthday'
        and n.metadata->>'birthday_date'=((now() at time zone 'Europe/Stockholm')::date)::text
        and exists(select 1 from public.family_members birthday_person where birthday_person.id::text=n.metadata->>'birthday_member_id' and birthday_person.family_id=m.family_id)))
      and (d.notification_id is null or (not d.finished and d.attempts < 3 and d.attempted_at < now() - interval '2 minutes'))
    order by n.created_at
    limit 50
  ), claimed as (
    insert into public.calendar_push_deliveries as d (notification_id, endpoint)
    select candidates.id, candidates.endpoint from candidates
    on conflict on constraint calendar_push_deliveries_pkey do update
      set attempted_at = now(), attempts = d.attempts + 1
      where not d.finished and d.attempts < 3 and d.attempted_at < now() - interval '2 minutes'
    returning d.notification_id, d.endpoint
  )
  select c.notification_id, c.endpoint, s.p256dh, s.auth_key
  from claimed c
  join public.calendar_push_subscriptions s on s.endpoint = c.endpoint;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_wishlist_items(p_wishlist_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, url text, price numeric, purchased boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare actor public.family_members;
begin
 select me.* into actor from public.family_members me join public.family_wishlists w on w.family_id=me.family_id
 where w.id=p_wishlist_id and me.user_id=(select auth.uid());
 if actor.id is null then raise exception 'Önskelistan är inte tillgänglig.' using errcode='42501';end if;
 return query select i.id,i.title,i.url,i.price,case when actor.role='barn' then false else i.purchased end
 from public.family_wishlist_items i where i.wishlist_id=p_wishlist_id order by i.created_at,i.id;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_birthday_countdown()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 insert into public.member_countdowns(member_id,kind,title,emoji,target_date,birthday_month,birthday_day)
 values(new.member_id,'birthday','Min födelsedag','🎂',make_date(2000,extract(month from new.birth_date)::int,extract(day from new.birth_date)::int),extract(month from new.birth_date)::int,extract(day from new.birth_date)::int)
 on conflict(member_id) do update set target_date=excluded.target_date,birthday_month=excluded.birthday_month,birthday_day=excluded.birthday_day,updated_at=now()
 where public.member_countdowns.kind='birthday';
 return new;
end;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deliver_family_birthdays()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare today date:=(now() at time zone 'Europe/Stockholm')::date; added integer;
begin
 if (now() at time zone 'Europe/Stockholm')::time < time '09:00' then return 0; end if;
 insert into public.notifications(family_id,recipient_member_id,type,title,body,href,metadata)
 select person.family_id,recipient.id,'system',case when person.id=recipient.id then 'Grattis på födelsedagen! 🎂' else person.display_name||' fyller år idag! 🎂' end,
 'Dags att fira tillsammans.','/notiser',jsonb_build_object('action','birthday','birthday_member_id',person.id,'birthday_date',today)
 from public.member_birthdays b join public.family_members person on person.id=b.member_id join public.family_members recipient on recipient.family_id=person.family_id
 where extract(month from b.birth_date)=extract(month from today)
 and least(extract(day from b.birth_date)::int,extract(day from (date_trunc('month',today)+interval '1 month - 1 day'))::int)=extract(day from today)
 on conflict do nothing;
 get diagnostics added=row_count; return added;
end;$function$
